description: Deletes an event from Google Calendar. This action is permanent and cannot be undone. Optionally sends cancellation notifications to attendees.

calendar_id.description: Calendar ID containing the event. Defaults to "primary".

event_id.description: The ID of the event to delete.

send_updates.description: Whether to send cancellation notifications. "all" sends to all attendees, "externalOnly" to external attendees only, "none" sends no notifications.

name: delete_calendar_event
